battle.abilities.smoke_bomb.description.en: Throw it over your warriors as they walk into a defense's range. For 8 seconds, warriors inside the cloud can only be shot from close up (Night Blades also hit buildings inside it twice as hard).
battle.abilities.smoke_bomb.description.text: Jù ú sórí àwọn jagunjagun rẹ bí wọ́n ṣe ń wọ àrọ́wọ́tó ilé ààbò kan. Fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 8, àwọn jagunjagun inú ìkùukùu náà ni a lè ta láti tòsí nìkan (Idà Òru tún ń kọlu àwọn ilé inú rẹ̀ ní ìlọ́po méjì).

battle.heroes.shadow_captain.description.en: Clan hero. On his first strike he rallies nearby warriors: 30% more damage for 8 seconds, once per battle.
battle.heroes.shadow_captain.description.text: Akọni ìdílé. Ní ìkọlù rẹ̀ àkọ́kọ́, ó ń kó àwọn jagunjagun tí ó wà nítòsí jọ: ìpalára 30% sí i fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 8, ẹ̀ẹ̀kan nínú ogun kọ̀ọ̀kan.

buildings.elder_toadstool.description.en: The hidden heart of your clan. Upgrade it to unlock new buildings, warriors and higher levels.
buildings.elder_toadstool.description.text: Ọkàn àṣírí ìdílé rẹ. Ṣe àgbéga rẹ̀ láti ṣí àwọn ilé tuntun, jagunjagun àti ìpele gíga.

buildings.acorn_orchard.description.en: Artisans stamp fresh Coins every hour. Holds 8 hours of output, so collect often.
buildings.acorn_orchard.description.text: Àwọn oníṣẹ́-ọnà ń tẹ Owó-ẹyọ tuntun ní wákàtí kọ̀ọ̀kan. Ó ń gba èso wákàtí 8, nítorí náà máa kó o jọ lóòrèkóòrè.

buildings.dewdrop_well.description.en: Terraced fields that grow Provisions for your warriors. Holds 8 hours of output.
buildings.dewdrop_well.description.text: Àwọn oko àtẹ̀gùn tí ń gbin Oúnjẹ fún àwọn jagunjagun rẹ. Ó ń gba èso wákàtí 8.

buildings.acorn_silo.description.en: A locked vault for your Coins. Bigger treasuries let you save for bigger upgrades.
buildings.acorn_silo.description.text: Àpótí títìpa fún Owó-ẹyọ rẹ. Ilé ìṣúra ńlá ń jẹ́ kí o fi owó pamọ́ fún àgbéga ńlá.

buildings.dew_cistern.description.en: Stores Provisions for your warriors. Raiders can only carry off part of what is inside.
buildings.dew_cistern.description.text: Ó ń tọ́jú Oúnjẹ fún àwọn jagunjagun rẹ. Àwọn agbógunti lè kó apá kan nínú ohun tí ó wà nínú rẹ̀ nìkan.

buildings.beaver_lodge.description.en: Home of a Village Artisan. Each hut lets you build or upgrade one thing at a time.
buildings.beaver_lodge.description.text: Ilé Oníṣẹ́-ọnà Abúlé kan. Ahéré kọ̀ọ̀kan ń jẹ́ kí o kọ́ tàbí ṣe àgbéga ohun kan ní àkókò kan.

buildings.burrow_barracks.description.en: Trains warriors and studies battle scrolls to make them stronger. Higher levels unlock new warriors.
buildings.burrow_barracks.description.text: Ó ń dá àwọn jagunjagun lẹ́kọ̀ọ́, ó sì ń ka ìwé-àkájọ ogun láti mú wọn lágbára sí i. Ìpele gíga ń ṣí àwọn jagunjagun tuntun.

buildings.army_camp.description.en: Where trained warriors wait for the next raid. Each level houses more.
buildings.army_camp.description.text: Ibi tí àwọn jagunjagun tí a ti dá lẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ti ń dúró de ìgbógunti tó kàn. Ìpele kọ̀ọ̀kan ń gba púpọ̀ sí i.

buildings.acorn_cannon.description.en: A lookout that throws volleys of kunai at warriors on the ground. Cannot hit flyers.
buildings.acorn_cannon.description.text: Ilé-ìṣọ́ tí ń ju ọ̀pọ̀ kunai sí àwọn jagunjagun orí ilẹ̀. Kò lè ta àwọn tí ń fò.

buildings.pinecone_catapult.description.en: Launches bursting fireworks that splash groups of warriors on the ground. Slow, and blind to warriors right beside it.
buildings.pinecone_catapult.description.text: Ó ń ta iná àríyá tí ń bú gbàù sí àwọn ẹgbẹ́ jagunjagun orí ilẹ̀. Ó lọ́ra, kò sì rí àwọn jagunjagun tí ó wà lẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ rẹ̀ gan-an.

buildings.wasp_nest.description.en: Spinning shuriken strike warriors on the ground and in the air.
buildings.wasp_nest.description.text: Shuriken tí ń yí ń kọlu àwọn jagunjagun orí ilẹ̀ àti ojú ọ̀run.

buildings.firefly_tower.description.en: Archers with great bows that hit flying warriors hard. Ignores warriors on the ground.
buildings.firefly_tower.description.text: Àwọn tafàtafà pẹ̀lú ọrun ńlá tí ń kọlu àwọn jagunjagun tí ń fò gidigidi. Kò bìkítà fún àwọn jagunjagun orí ilẹ̀.

buildings.bramble_hedge.description.en: Fitted mountain stone. Warriors walk around it or break through it. Higher levels add iron-banded gates. Builds instantly.
buildings.bramble_hedge.description.text: Òkúta òkè tí a tò pọ̀. Àwọn jagunjagun ń rìn yí i ká tàbí fọ́ ọ wọlé. Ìpele gíga ń fi ẹnubodè onírin kún un. A ń kọ́ ọ lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀.

buildings.thorn_snare.description.en: A hidden pit of bamboo spikes that springs when warriors on the ground step close. Unseen until it goes off.
buildings.thorn_snare.description.text: Kòtò àṣírí tí ó kún fún ẹ̀gún oparun, tí ń ṣí nígbà tí àwọn jagunjagun orí ilẹ̀ bá sún mọ́ ọn. A kò rí i títí yóò fi ṣiṣẹ́.

buildings.sap_puddle.description.en: Hidden iron caltrops that slow warriors on the ground to half speed for a few seconds.
buildings.sap_puddle.description.text: Ẹ̀gún irin àṣírí tí ń dín ìyára àwọn jagunjagun orí ilẹ̀ kù sí ìdajì fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá díẹ̀.

buildings.flower_bed.description.en: A carefully shaped little pine. Purely decorative.
buildings.flower_bed.description.text: Igi páìnì kékeré tí a ṣe ní ìrísí pẹ̀lú ìṣọ́ra. Fún ẹwà nìkan.

buildings.lantern_post.description.en: A carved stone lantern that glows through the night. Purely decorative.
buildings.lantern_post.description.text: Àtùpà òkúta gbígbẹ́ tí ń tàn ní gbogbo òru. Fún ẹwà nìkan.

buildings.mushroom_ring.description.en: Raked gravel and three quiet stones. Purely decorative.
buildings.mushroom_ring.description.text: Òkúta wẹ́wẹ́ tí a ṣà àti òkúta ìdákẹ́jẹ́ẹ́ mẹ́ta. Fún ẹwà nìkan.

buildings.mossy_statue.description.en: A weathered stone sentinel that watches the gate. Purely decorative.
buildings.mossy_statue.description.text: Olùṣọ́ òkúta tí ojú ọjọ́ ti pa lára, tí ń ṣọ́ ẹnubodè. Fún ẹwà nìkan.

buildings.obstacle_bush.description.en: Clear it to make room. You might find Jade!
buildings.obstacle_bush.description.text: Ko ó kúrò láti ní àyè. O lè rí Jéèdì!

buildings.obstacle_stump.description.en: Clear it to make room. You might find Jade!
buildings.obstacle_stump.description.text: Ko ó kúrò láti ní àyè. O lè rí Jéèdì!

buildings.obstacle_rock.description.en: Clear it to make room. You might find Jade!
buildings.obstacle_rock.description.text: Ko ó kúrò láti ní àyè. O lè rí Jéèdì!

buildings.grove_lodge.description.en: Your link to your Alliance. Holds the warriors your allies send you, ready for your next raid.
buildings.grove_lodge.description.text: Ìsopọ̀ rẹ pẹ̀lú Àjọṣepọ̀ rẹ. Ó ń gba àwọn jagunjagun tí àwọn alájọṣe rẹ fi ránṣẹ́ sí ọ, tí wọ́n ṣetán fún ìgbógunti rẹ tó kàn.

buildings.paper_lantern_line.description.en: Lanterns strung low between posts. Hidden or mist-veiled ground warriors within 2 tiles are lit up for a few seconds: defenses can see them, and lit warriors take extra damage. Once it has lit someone, the line itself is no longer hidden.
buildings.paper_lantern_line.description.text: Àwọn àtùpà tí a so mọ́lẹ̀ láàrin àwọn òpó. Àwọn jagunjagun orí ilẹ̀ tí ó farapamọ́ tàbí tí ìkùukùu bò láàrin ààyè 2 ni a ń tan ìmọ́lẹ̀ sí fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá díẹ̀: àwọn ilé ààbò lè rí wọn, àwọn jagunjagun tí ìmọ́lẹ̀ wà lára wọn sì ń farapa sí i. Ní kété tí ó bá ti tan ìmọ́lẹ̀ sí ẹnìkan, ọ̀wọ́ náà fúnra rẹ̀ kò farapamọ́ mọ́.

buildings.clockwork_repairer.description.en: A mechanic's crane that reaches over nearby defenses: jams, stuns and a Hawk Tamer's slowing on defenses within 3 tiles are cut short. A few repairs per battle.
buildings.clockwork_repairer.description.text: Kíréènì oníṣẹ́-ẹ̀rọ tí ń nà dé àwọn ilé ààbò tí ó wà nítòsí: ìdílọ́wọ́, ìdákú àti ìdínkù ìyára láti ọwọ́ Olùtọ́jú Àṣá lórí ilé ààbò láàrin ààyè 3 ni a ń gé kúrú. Àtúnṣe díẹ̀ nínú ogun kọ̀ọ̀kan.

buildings.bitter_incense_burner.descript.en: Burns bitter herbs: warriors within 3 tiles receive less healing, and healing, haste and toughness auras and shelter shields work at reduced strength on them.
buildings.bitter_incense_burner.descript.text: Ó ń sun ewé kíkorò: àwọn jagunjagun láàrin ààyè 3 ń gba ìwòsàn díẹ̀, àti pé agbára ìwòsàn, ìyára, líle àti apata ààbò ń ṣiṣẹ́ ní agbára díẹ̀ lórí wọn.

buildings.kite_cutter_ballista.descripti.en: Air only. Fires a spinning bolas that tangles anything with wings or strings: a flyer it hits is grounded for 3 seconds, where ground defenses can reach it. A flyer that breaks free can't be tangled again for 3 seconds.
buildings.kite_cutter_ballista.descripti.text: Ojú ọ̀run nìkan. Ó ń ta okùn olókùúta tí ń yí, tí ń dì ohunkóhun tí ó ní ìyẹ́ tàbí okùn: ẹni tí ń fò tí ó bá bà á yóò wà lórí ilẹ̀ fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 3, níbi tí àwọn ilé ààbò orí ilẹ̀ ti lè dé ọ̀dọ̀ rẹ̀. Ẹni tí ń fò tí ó bá já ara rẹ̀ sílẹ̀ kò ṣeé dì mọ́ fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 3.

buildings.longbow_yagura.description.en: A tall archery tower with range 13 that outranges every siege warrior. It prefers warriors attacking from 3.5 tiles or more (throwers and artillery), but cannot hit anything closer than 2 tiles.
buildings.longbow_yagura.description.text: Ilé-ìṣọ́ tafàtafà gíga pẹ̀lú àrọ́wọ́tó 13 tí ó jìnnà ju ti gbogbo jagunjagun ìsàgatì lọ. Ó fẹ́ràn àwọn jagunjagun tí ń kọlù láti ààyè 3.5 tàbí jù bẹ́ẹ̀ lọ (àwọn olùjù-nǹkan àti àgbá ogun), ṣùgbọ́n kò lè ta ohunkóhun tí ó sún mọ́ ọn ju ààyè 2 lọ.

events.schedule.harvest_moon.description.en: Collecting from Coin Mints and Terraced Farms gives 30% extra.
events.schedule.harvest_moon.description.text: Kíkó jọ láti Ilé Ìṣẹ́ Owó àti Oko Àtẹ̀gùn ń fúnni ní 30% sí i.

events.schedule.raiders_moon.description.text: Ìkọlù tí o bá borí ń mú ìkógun 20% sí i wá.

events.schedule.swift_paws.description.text: Dídá jagunjagun lẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ń ná Oúnjẹ tí ó dín ní 25%.

events.schedule.bounty_hunt.description.en: A rival warlord's fortress has a bounty on it. Attack it as often as you like while the hunt lasts: each mark on the reward ladder pays once.
events.schedule.bounty_hunt.description.text: Èrè wà lórí ibi olódi ọ̀gágun abánidíje kan. Kọlù ú ní iye ìgbà tí o bá fẹ́ nígbà tí ọdẹ náà ń lọ: àmì kọ̀ọ̀kan lórí àtẹ̀gùn ẹ̀bùn ń sanwó lẹ́ẹ̀kan.

events.schedule.raiders_moon_2.descripti.text: Ìkọlù tí o bá borí ń mú ìkógun 20% sí i wá.

names.rivalClans.crimson_lotus.bio.en: A river clan that trades in secrets. Akane never fights where she can be seen; her outposts lean on traps and mortars.
names.rivalClans.crimson_lotus.bio.text: Ìdílé etí odò tí ń ṣòwò àṣírí. Akane kì í jà níbi tí a ti lè rí i; àwọn ibùdó rẹ̀ gbára lé ìdẹkùn àti àgbá iná.

names.rivalClans.iron_tide.bio.en: Salt-hardened raiders from the coast. Gorō builds thick walls and dares you to break them.
names.rivalClans.iron_tide.bio.text: Àwọn agbógunti etí òkun tí iyọ̀ ti mú le. Gorō ń kọ́ ògiri tí ó nípọn, ó sì ń pè ọ́ níjà láti fọ́ wọn.

names.rivalClans.moon_veil.bio.en: Mountain hermits who see in the dark. Yoru spreads her towers wide so no path is safe.
names.rivalClans.moon_veil.bio.text: Àwọn adáwà orí òkè tí ń ríran nínú òkùnkùn. Yoru ń tú àwọn ilé-ìṣọ́ rẹ̀ ká jìnnà kí ọ̀nà kankan má bàa ní ààbò.

notifications.types.raided.label.text: Wọ́n gbógun ti abúlé rẹ (orí ayélujára)

notifications.types.donations.label.text: Jagunjagun dé láti Àjọṣepọ̀ rẹ (orí ayélujára)

notifications.types.gangWar.label.en: Gang War found, battle day, 2 hours left, relay turn, under attack (online)
notifications.types.gangWar.label.text: A rí Ogun Ẹgbẹ́, ọjọ́ ogun, wákàtí 2 ló kù, àkókò ìfirọ́pò, wọ́n ń kọlù ọ́ (orí ayélujára)

notifications.types.friends.label.en: Friend requests, duels and duel challenges (online)
notifications.types.friends.label.text: Ìbéèrè ọ̀rẹ́, ìfẹ̀sọ̀jà àti ìpèníjà ìfẹ̀sọ̀jà (orí ayélujára)

offers.rules.starter_pack.description.en: A one-time boost for new clan leaders: Jade and resources to speed things up.
offers.rules.starter_pack.description.text: Ìrànlọ́wọ́ ẹ̀ẹ̀kan fún àwọn aṣáájú ìdílé tuntun: Jéèdì àti ohun-ìní láti mú nǹkan yára.

offers.rules.builder_pack.description.en: Jade to hire another Village Artisan, plus a little extra.
offers.rules.builder_pack.description.text: Jéèdì láti gba Oníṣẹ́-ọnà Abúlé mìíràn síṣẹ́, pẹ̀lú díẹ̀ sí i.

offers.rules.war_prep_pack.description.en: Get ready for the Alliance War: Provisions for your warriors, and Jade.
offers.rules.war_prep_pack.description.text: Múra sílẹ̀ fún Ogun Àjọṣepọ̀: Oúnjẹ fún àwọn jagunjagun rẹ, àti Jéèdì.

offers.rules.keep_pack.description.en: Your Keep grew. Supplies sized for your new Keep level, and Jade.
offers.rules.keep_pack.description.text: Ilé Olódi rẹ ti dàgbà. Ìpèsè tí ó bá ìpele Ilé Olódi tuntun rẹ mu, àti Jéèdì.

offers.rules.rebuild_pack.description.en: Raiders hit hard. Restock your storage.
offers.rules.rebuild_pack.description.text: Àwọn agbógunti kọlù gidigidi. Tún àwọn àká rẹ kún.

pass.weeklyChallenges.w_win_raids.text.text: Borí nínú ìgbógunti {n} ní ọ̀sẹ̀ yìí

pass.weeklyChallenges.w_clear.text.text: Ko ìdíwọ́ {n} kúrò ní ọ̀sẹ̀ yìí

pass.weeklyChallenges.w_destruction.text.en: Destroy {n}% in raids this week (added up)
pass.weeklyChallenges.w_destruction.text.text: Pa {n}% run nínú ìgbógunti ní ọ̀sẹ̀ yìí (àròpọ̀)

pass.weeklyChallenges.w_trials.text.en: Clear {n} new Shadow Trial tiers this week
pass.weeklyChallenges.w_trials.text.text: Parí ìpele Ìdánwò Òjìji tuntun {n} ní ọ̀sẹ̀ yìí

progression.roles.blade.summary.en: Fast melee that strikes the nearest building.
progression.roles.blade.summary.text: Ajàtòsí yíyára tí ń kọlu ilé tí ó sún mọ́ ọn jùlọ.

progression.roles.thrower.summary.en: Fragile ranged damage from behind the front line.
progression.roles.thrower.summary.text: Ìpalára láti ọ̀nà jíjìn, ẹlẹgẹ́, láti ẹ̀yìn ìlà iwájú.

progression.roles.guardian.summary.en: Armored frontliner that walks into defenses and soaks fire.
progression.roles.guardian.summary.text: Jagunjagun iwájú onihamọ́ra tí ń rìn wọ inú ààbò, tí ó sì ń fara da iná.

progression.roles.saboteur.summary.en: Specialist that disables defenses for a short time.
progression.roles.saboteur.summary.text: Akọ̀ṣẹ́mọṣẹ́ tí ń pa àwọn ilé ààbò lẹ́nu mọ́ fún ìgbà díẹ̀.

progression.roles.infiltrator.summary.en: Gets past walls by tunnel, rope or rooftop.
progression.roles.infiltrator.summary.text: Ó ń kọjá ògiri nípasẹ̀ ihò abẹ́lẹ̀, okùn tàbí òrùlé.

progression.roles.sky.summary.en: Flies over everything; only anti-air can touch it, so it is fragile and hits lighter.
progression.roles.sky.summary.text: Ó ń fò lórí ohun gbogbo; ìdojúkọ ojú ọ̀run nìkan ló lè kàn án, nítorí náà ó jẹ́ ẹlẹgẹ́, ó sì ń bani jẹ́ díẹ̀.

progression.roles.mystic.summary.en: Supports nearby warriors: heals, haste, shields.
progression.roles.mystic.summary.text: Ó ń ran àwọn jagunjagun tí ó wà nítòsí lọ́wọ́: ìwòsàn, ìyára, apata.

progression.roles.siege.summary.en: Breaks walls and buildings fast; weak against defenses.
progression.roles.siege.summary.text: Ó ń fọ́ ògiri àti ilé kíákíá; ó lágbára díẹ̀ níwájú ààbò.

progression.roles.beast.summary.en: Handlers and their animals: numbers and charges.
progression.roles.beast.summary.text: Àwọn olùtọ́jú àti ẹranko wọn: iye púpọ̀ àti ìkọlù ìrọ́lù.

progression.roles.shadow.summary.text: Ìfarapamọ́: a kò rí i títí yóò fi kọlù.

progression.buildingCatalog.scroll_libra.en: Moves warrior research out of the Training Dojo and studies mastery scrolls.
progression.buildingCatalog.scroll_libra.text: Ó ń gbé ìwádìí jagunjagun kúrò ní Dojo Ìdánrawò, ó sì ń ka ìwé-àkájọ ọ̀gá.

progression.buildingCatalog.shadow_ink_w.en: Distils Shadow Ink, the third currency, used for Veteran-tier warriors and heroes.
progression.buildingCatalog.shadow_ink_w.text: Ó ń ṣe Ínkì Òjìji, owó kẹta, tí a ń lò fún àwọn jagunjagun ìpele Ògbóǹtarìgì àti àwọn akọni.

progression.buildingCatalog.reinforced_g.en: A wall segment with an iron-banded gate; tougher than stone and opens only for defenders.
progression.buildingCatalog.reinforced_g.text: Apá ògiri kan pẹ̀lú ẹnubodè onírin; ó le ju òkúta lọ, ó sì ń ṣí fún àwọn olùgbèjà nìkan.

progression.buildingCatalog.sky_net.desc.en: Hidden net that snares flyers for a few seconds.
progression.buildingCatalog.sky_net.desc.text: Àwọ̀n àṣírí tí ń dẹkùn mú àwọn tí ń fò fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá díẹ̀.

progression.buildingCatalog.hero_shrine..en: Home of a clan hero; one hall per hero.
progression.buildingCatalog.hero_shrine..text: Ilé akọni ìdílé kan; gbọ̀ngàn kan fún akọni kọ̀ọ̀kan.

progression.buildingCatalog.temple_bell_.en: Rings when warriors approach: reveals Shadow warriors and halves smoke duration nearby.
progression.buildingCatalog.temple_bell_.text: Ó ń dún nígbà tí àwọn jagunjagun bá ń sún mọ́ ọn: ó ń fi àwọn jagunjagun Òjìji hàn, ó sì ń dín àkókò èéfín nítòsí kù sí ìdajì.

progression.buildingCatalog.clan_forge.d.en: Forges equipment that adds small bonuses to one role at a time.
progression.buildingCatalog.clan_forge.d.text: Ó ń rọ ohun-èlò tí ń fi àfikún kékeré fún ipa kan ní àkókò kan.

progression.buildingCatalog.wind_chime_w.en: Tripwire that slows and reveals everything that crosses it.
progression.buildingCatalog.wind_chime_w.text: Okùn ìdẹkùn tí ń dín ìyára ohun gbogbo tí ó bá kọjá rẹ̀ kù, tí ó sì ń fi í hàn.

progression.buildingCatalog.crossbow_bas.en: Fires at three targets at once.
progression.buildingCatalog.crossbow_bas.text: Ó ń ta àfojúsùn mẹ́ta lẹ́ẹ̀kan náà.

progression.buildingCatalog.flame_trench.en: A trench that bursts into flame under warriors on the ground.
progression.buildingCatalog.flame_trench.text: Kòtò tí ń rú iná sókè lábẹ́ àwọn jagunjagun orí ilẹ̀.

progression.buildingCatalog.thunder_shri.en: Chain lightning that jumps between flyers.
progression.buildingCatalog.thunder_shri.text: Mànàmáná ẹ̀wọ̀n tí ń fò láti ọ̀dọ̀ ẹni tí ń fò kan sí òmíràn.

progression.buildingCatalog.ninja_watch_.en: Sends out defending ninja who chase attackers.
progression.buildingCatalog.ninja_watch_.text: Ó ń rán àwọn ninja olùgbèjà jáde tí ń lé àwọn akọlù.

progression.buildingCatalog.great_dragon.en: The keep's last word: enormous damage, very slow.
progression.buildingCatalog.great_dragon.text: Ọ̀rọ̀ ìkẹyìn ilé olódi: ìpalára tí ó pọ̀ gan-an, ó lọ́ra gidigidi.

progression.buildingCatalog.whirling_bla.en: Short-range spinning blades hit every ground warrior within 1.2 tiles. Punishes cheap melee swarms; useless against anything that stands back.
progression.buildingCatalog.whirling_bla.text: Idà yíyí tí kò jìnnà ń kọlu gbogbo jagunjagun orí ilẹ̀ láàrin ààyè 1.2. Ó ń jẹ ọ̀pọ̀ ajàtòsí olówó-pọ́ọ́kú níyà; kò wúlò sí ohunkóhun tí ó dúró sẹ́yìn.

progression.buildingCatalog.paper_lanter.en: Lanterns strung low between posts. Hidden or mist-veiled ground warriors within 2 tiles are lit up for a few seconds: defenses can see them, and lit warriors take extra damage. Once it has lit someone, the line itself is no longer hidden.
progression.buildingCatalog.paper_lanter.text: Àwọn àtùpà tí a so mọ́lẹ̀ láàrin àwọn òpó. Àwọn jagunjagun orí ilẹ̀ tí ó farapamọ́ tàbí tí ìkùukùu bò láàrin ààyè 2 ni a ń tan ìmọ́lẹ̀ sí fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá díẹ̀: àwọn ilé ààbò lè rí wọn, àwọn jagunjagun tí ìmọ́lẹ̀ wà lára wọn sì ń farapa sí i. Ní kété tí ó bá ti tan ìmọ́lẹ̀ sí ẹnìkan, ọ̀wọ́ náà fúnra rẹ̀ kò farapamọ́ mọ́.

progression.buildingCatalog.rain_barrel_.en: Douses fire and rinses venom: burning and poison on buildings within 2.5 tiles end after 1 second, and firebomb splash there is 25% smaller. Wet ground conducts lightning, though.
progression.buildingCatalog.rain_barrel_.text: Ó ń pa iná, ó sì ń fọ májèlé kúrò: jíjóná àti májèlé lórí àwọn ilé láàrin ààyè 2.5 ń dópin lẹ́yìn ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 1, ìfọ́nká bọ́ǹbù iná níbẹ̀ sì kéré sí i ní 25%. Ṣùgbọ́n ilẹ̀ tútù ń gbé mànàmáná.

progression.buildingCatalog.listening_ja.en: Buried clay jars that amplify every sound underfoot. Diggers within 3 tiles are forced to the surface and stunned for 1 second; unseen walkers within 2 tiles are revealed.
progression.buildingCatalog.listening_ja.text: Ìkòkò amọ̀ tí a sin tí ń mú gbogbo ìró abẹ́ ẹsẹ̀ pọ̀ sí i. Àwọn awalẹ̀ láàrin ààyè 3 ni a fipá mú jáde sórí ilẹ̀, tí wọ́n sì dákú fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 1; àwọn arìnrìn àìrí láàrin ààyè 2 ni a ń fi hàn.

progression.buildingCatalog.living_bambo.en: A wall that grows back 3% of its health every second and is too springy to climb. Wall-breaking multipliers count half (a 4x ram hits for 2.5x).
progression.buildingCatalog.living_bambo.text: Ògiri tí ń tún 3% ìlera rẹ̀ dàgbà ní ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá kọ̀ọ̀kan, tí ó sì rọ jù láti gùn. Ìlọ́po ìfọ́-ògiri ń ka ìdajì (igi ìfọ́-ilẹ̀kùn 4x ń kọlù ní 2.5x).

progression.buildingCatalog.clockwork_re.en: A mechanic's crane that reaches over nearby defenses: jams, stuns and a Hawk Tamer's slowing on defenses within 3 tiles are cut short. A few repairs per battle.
progression.buildingCatalog.clockwork_re.text: Kíréènì oníṣẹ́-ẹ̀rọ tí ń nà dé àwọn ilé ààbò tí ó wà nítòsí: ìdílọ́wọ́, ìdákú àti ìdínkù ìyára láti ọwọ́ Olùtọ́jú Àṣá lórí ilé ààbò láàrin ààyè 3 ni a ń gé kúrú. Àtúnṣe díẹ̀ nínú ogun kọ̀ọ̀kan.

progression.buildingCatalog.bitter_incen.en: Burns bitter herbs: warriors within 3 tiles receive less healing, and healing, haste and toughness auras and shelter shields work at reduced strength on them.
progression.buildingCatalog.bitter_incen.text: Ó ń sun ewé kíkorò: àwọn jagunjagun láàrin ààyè 3 ń gba ìwòsàn díẹ̀, àti pé agbára ìwòsàn, ìyára, líle àti apata ààbò ń ṣiṣẹ́ ní agbára díẹ̀ lórí wọn.

progression.buildingCatalog.straw_scarec.en: Animals cannot resist it, and birds are terrified of it. Beasts, their companions and charging mounts within 3 tiles must attack it first, and crane gliders swerve away from it. Lots of health, no damage, very flammable.
progression.buildingCatalog.straw_scarec.text: Àwọn ẹranko kò lè kọjú ìjà sí i, ẹ̀rù rẹ̀ sì ń ba àwọn ẹyẹ. Àwọn ẹranko, àwọn alábàárìn wọn àti ẹran-gígùn tí ń rọ́lù láàrin ààyè 3 gbọ́dọ̀ kọ́kọ́ kọlù ú, àwọn Afòfò Ẹyẹ Àkọ̀ sì ń yà kúrò lọ́dọ̀ rẹ̀. Ìlera púpọ̀, kò sí ìpalára, ó ń tètè jóná.

progression.buildingCatalog.mirror_scree.en: Polished bronze panels: every third projectile that hits the screen flies back at whoever threw it. Melee warriors just walk up and smash it.
progression.buildingCatalog.mirror_scree.text: Pákó idẹ dídán: ohun ìjù kẹta kọ̀ọ̀kan tí ó bá ba gàgá náà ń fò padà sí ẹni tí ó jù ú. Àwọn ajàtòsí kàn ń rìn dé ọ̀dọ̀ rẹ̀, wọ́n sì ń fọ́ ọ.

progression.buildingCatalog.sand_bucket_.en: A bucket crew that smothers explosions and embers: splash damage within 3 tiles is 30% smaller, and they defuse up to two planted charges per battle.
progression.buildingCatalog.sand_bucket_.text: Ẹgbẹ́ olùgbé-garawa tí ń pa ìbúgbàù àti ẹyín-iná: ìpalára ìfọ́nká láàrin ààyè 3 kéré sí i ní 30%, wọ́n sì ń pa bọ́ǹbù tí a gbìn tó méjì nínú ogun kọ̀ọ̀kan.

progression.buildingCatalog.kite_cutter_.en: Air only. Fires a spinning bolas that tangles anything with wings or strings: a flyer it hits is grounded for 3 seconds, where ground defenses can reach it. A flyer that breaks free can't be tangled again for 3 seconds.
progression.buildingCatalog.kite_cutter_.text: Ojú ọ̀run nìkan. Ó ń ta okùn olókùúta tí ń yí, tí ń dì ohunkóhun tí ó ní ìyẹ́ tàbí okùn: ẹni tí ń fò tí ó bá bà á yóò wà lórí ilẹ̀ fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 3, níbi tí àwọn ilé ààbò orí ilẹ̀ ti lè dé ọ̀dọ̀ rẹ̀. Ẹni tí ń fò tí ó bá já ara rẹ̀ sílẹ̀ kò ṣeé dì mọ́ fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 3.

progression.buildingCatalog.discipline_b.en: A clan banner that keeps nearby defenders focused: defenses within 3 tiles ignore taunting bells and decoys.
progression.buildingCatalog.discipline_b.text: Àsíá ìdílé tí ń jẹ́ kí àwọn olùgbèjà tí ó wà nítòsí pọkàn pọ̀: àwọn ilé ààbò láàrin ààyè 3 kò bìkítà fún agogo ìtànjẹ àti ìdẹ.

progression.buildingCatalog.spotter_perc.en: A lookout who calls targets: defenses within 3 tiles retarget instantly onto warriors that dash, swing or shadow-step into range.
progression.buildingCatalog.spotter_perc.text: Olùṣọ́ tí ń pe àfojúsùn: àwọn ilé ààbò láàrin ààyè 3 ń yí àfojúsùn padà lẹ́sẹ̀kẹsẹ̀ sí àwọn jagunjagun tí ń sáré wọlé, tí ń yí, tàbí tí ń fò-òjìji wọ àrọ́wọ́tó.

progression.buildingCatalog.steam_vent.d.en: Blasts scalding steam in a 2-tile circle. It needs no target, so it hurts hidden warriors, blows smoke away from its tiles, and cannot be dodged.
progression.buildingCatalog.steam_vent.d.text: Ó ń fẹ́ ooru gbígbóná ní àyíká ààyè 2. Kò nílò àfojúsùn, nítorí náà ó ń ṣe àwọn jagunjagun tí ó farapamọ́ léṣe, ó ń fẹ́ èéfín kúrò ní àyè rẹ̀, a kò sì lè yẹ̀ ẹ́.

progression.buildingCatalog.sleep_dart_t.en: Darts that barely scratch but put a warrior to sleep for 2 seconds. The same warrior can only be put to sleep once. Best against a few big fighters.
progression.buildingCatalog.sleep_dart_t.text: Ọfà kékeré tí kò fi bẹ́ẹ̀ ṣeni léṣe ṣùgbọ́n tí ń mú jagunjagun sùn fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 2. Jagunjagun kan náà ni a lè mú sùn lẹ́ẹ̀kan ṣoṣo. Ó dára jùlọ sí àwọn ajagun ńlá díẹ̀.

progression.buildingCatalog.rolling_log_.en: Releases a log down a 1-tile lane: heavy damage to every ground warrior in the line. It is not splash, so tower shields do not stop it. Punishes clumped buff squads.
progression.buildingCatalog.rolling_log_.text: Ó ń tú igi kan sílẹ̀ gba ọ̀nà ààyè 1: ìpalára ńlá sí gbogbo jagunjagun orí ilẹ̀ tí ó wà ní ìlà náà. Kì í ṣe ìfọ́nká, nítorí náà apata ilé-ìṣọ́ kò lè dá a dúró. Ó ń jẹ àwọn ẹgbẹ́ olùrànlọ́wọ́ tí ó kóra jọ níyà.

progression.buildingCatalog.moonlit_grav.en: Raked gravel that crunches: anything that teleports, lands or rushes onto it is stunned for 1.5 seconds.
progression.buildingCatalog.moonlit_grav.text: Òkúta wẹ́wẹ́ tí a ṣà tí ń dún: ohunkóhun tí ó bá fò dé, bọ́ sí, tàbí sáré wọ orí rẹ̀ yóò dákú fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 1.5.

progression.buildingCatalog.ink_seal_pos.en: Warriors who fall within 3 tiles are sealed in ink: they cannot be revived, and nothing bails out of them.
progression.buildingCatalog.ink_seal_pos.text: Àwọn jagunjagun tí ó ṣubú láàrin ààyè 3 ni a fi ínkì dì: a kò lè jí wọn dìde, kò sì sí ohun tí yóò jáde láti ara wọn.

progression.buildingCatalog.longbow_yagu.en: A tall archery tower with range 13 that outranges every siege warrior. It prefers warriors attacking from 3.5 tiles or more (throwers and artillery), but cannot hit anything closer than 2 tiles.
progression.buildingCatalog.longbow_yagu.text: Ilé-ìṣọ́ tafàtafà gíga pẹ̀lú àrọ́wọ́tó 13 tí ó jìnnà ju ti gbogbo jagunjagun ìsàgatì lọ. Ó fẹ́ràn àwọn jagunjagun tí ń kọlù láti ààyè 3.5 tàbí jù bẹ́ẹ̀ lọ (àwọn olùjù-nǹkan àti àgbá ogun), ṣùgbọ́n kò lè ta ohunkóhun tí ó sún mọ́ ọn ju ààyè 2 lọ.

progression.buildingCatalog.lightning_ro.en: Grounds lightning: chained slashes and lightning strikes within 3 tiles hit the rod instead, charging it. When fully charged it fires the lightning back.
progression.buildingCatalog.lightning_ro.text: Ó ń fa mànàmáná sílẹ̀: àwọn ìgé ẹ̀wọ̀n àti mànàmáná láàrin ààyè 3 ń ba ọ̀pá náà dípò, wọ́n sì ń kún un ní agbára. Nígbà tí agbára rẹ̀ bá kún, ó ń ta mànàmáná náà padà.

roster.warriors.shinobi.ability.text.en: Cheap and fast; the first warrior every clan trains.
roster.warriors.shinobi.ability.text.text: Olówó-pọ́ọ́kú àti yíyára; jagunjagun àkọ́kọ́ tí gbogbo ìdílé ń dá lẹ́kọ̀ọ́.

roster.warriors.twin_fang_dancer.ability.en: Every hit lands twice, on its target and the next building beside it.
roster.warriors.twin_fang_dancer.ability.text: Ìkọlù kọ̀ọ̀kan ń ba ibi méjì: àfojúsùn rẹ̀ àti ilé tó kàn lẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ rẹ̀.

roster.warriors.wind_step_assassin.abili.en: Dashes to a new target; the first hit after each dash deals double damage.
roster.warriors.wind_step_assassin.abili.text: Ó ń sáré lọ sí àfojúsùn tuntun; ìkọlù àkọ́kọ́ lẹ́yìn ìsáré kọ̀ọ̀kan ń ṣe ìpalára ìlọ́po méjì.

roster.warriors.moonblade_master.ability.en: Every fourth strike is a crescent slash for 2.5x damage.
roster.warriors.moonblade_master.ability.text: Ìkọlù kẹrin kọ̀ọ̀kan jẹ́ ìgé bí òṣùpá ẹ̀ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ yọ fún ìpalára 2.5x.

roster.warriors.storm_sovereign.ability..en: Slashes arc between up to three nearby buildings.
roster.warriors.storm_sovereign.ability..text: Ìgé rẹ̀ ń fò láàrin ilé mẹ́ta tí ó wà nítòsí.

roster.warriors.kunai_adept.ability.text.en: Fragile ranged damage from behind the front line.
roster.warriors.kunai_adept.ability.text.text: Ìpalára láti ọ̀nà jíjìn, ẹlẹgẹ́, láti ẹ̀yìn ìlà iwájú.

roster.warriors.shuriken_storm.ability.t.en: Throws three shuriken at once; small splash.
roster.warriors.shuriken_storm.ability.t.text: Ó ń ju shuriken mẹ́ta lẹ́ẹ̀kan náà; ìfọ́nká kékeré.

roster.warriors.blowgun_hunter.ability.t.en: Darts keep damaging a building for 5 seconds.
roster.warriors.blowgun_hunter.ability.t.text: Àwọn ọfà ń bá a lọ láti ba ilé jẹ́ fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 5.

roster.warriors.chain_sickle_reaper.abil.en: Hits make the target take 20% more damage from everyone.
roster.warriors.chain_sickle_reaper.abil.text: Ìkọlù rẹ̀ ń mú kí àfojúsùn farapa sí i ní 20% láti ọwọ́ gbogbo ènìyàn.

roster.warriors.thousand_needle.ability..en: Very long range and rapid fire; must stay behind cover.
roster.warriors.thousand_needle.ability..text: Àrọ́wọ́tó jíjìn gan-an àti ìtafà kíákíá; ó gbọ́dọ̀ dúró sí ẹ̀yìn ààbò.

roster.warriors.armored_guardian.ability.en: Walks straight into defenses and soaks their fire.
roster.warriors.armored_guardian.ability.text: Ó ń rìn tààrà wọ inú ààbò, ó sì ń fara da iná wọn.

roster.warriors.iron_monk.ability.text.en: Warriors beside him take 15% less damage.
roster.warriors.iron_monk.ability.text.text: Àwọn jagunjagun lẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ rẹ̀ ń farapa díẹ̀ ní 15%.

roster.warriors.bell_warden.ability.text.en: Rings a bell that makes defenses in range target him first.
roster.warriors.bell_warden.ability.text.text: Ó ń lu agogo tí ń mú kí àwọn ilé ààbò tí ó wà ní àrọ́wọ́tó kọ́kọ́ dojú kọ ọ́.

roster.warriors.mountain_shield.ability..en: Carries a tower shield that absorbs splash for allies behind him.
roster.warriors.mountain_shield.ability..text: Ó ń gbé apata gígùn tí ń gba ìfọ́nká fún àwọn alájọṣe tí ó wà lẹ́yìn rẹ̀.

roster.warriors.oni_breaker.ability.text.en: Huge health; smashes walls for five times damage.
roster.warriors.oni_breaker.ability.text.text: Ìlera ńlá; ó ń fọ́ ògiri pẹ̀lú ìpalára ìlọ́po márùn-ún.

roster.warriors.saboteur.ability.text.en: Jams the nearest working defense for 6 seconds (once per Saboteur).
roster.warriors.saboteur.ability.text.text: Ó ń dí ilé ààbò tí ń ṣiṣẹ́ tí ó sún mọ́ ọn jùlọ lọ́wọ́ fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 6 (ẹ̀ẹ̀kan fún Abàjẹ́ kọ̀ọ̀kan).

roster.warriors.trap_breaker.ability.tex.en: Finds and disarms hidden traps along the squad's path.
roster.warriors.trap_breaker.ability.tex.text: Ó ń rí àwọn ìdẹkùn àṣírí lójú ọ̀nà ẹgbẹ́ náà, ó sì ń tú wọn ká.

roster.warriors.gearbreaker.ability.text.en: Two jams per warrior, each lasting 9 seconds.
roster.warriors.gearbreaker.ability.text.text: Ìdílọ́wọ́ méjì fún jagunjagun kọ̀ọ̀kan, ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 9.

roster.warriors.fuse_master.ability.text.en: Plants a charge on a defense that explodes after 5 seconds.
roster.warriors.fuse_master.ability.text.text: Ó ń gbin bọ́ǹbù sórí ilé ààbò kan tí yóò bú gbàù lẹ́yìn ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 5.

roster.warriors.ghost_engineer.ability.t.en: Once per battle, jams up to three defenses within 3 tiles for 4 seconds. Shares jam immunity with other specialists.
roster.warriors.ghost_engineer.ability.t.text: Ẹ̀ẹ̀kan nínú ogun, ó ń dí ilé ààbò tó mẹ́ta láàrin ààyè 3 lọ́wọ́ fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 4. Ó ń pín àìlèdílọ́wọ́ pẹ̀lú àwọn akọ̀ṣẹ́mọṣẹ́ mìíràn.

roster.warriors.tunnel_runner.ability.te.en: Digs under walls to reach any building.
roster.warriors.tunnel_runner.ability.te.text: Ó ń wa ilẹ̀ lábẹ́ ògiri láti dé ilé èyíkéyìí.

roster.warriors.wall_climber.ability.tex.en: Climbs over walls and goes for storehouses first.
roster.warriors.wall_climber.ability.tex.text: Ó ń gun orí ògiri kọjá, ó sì ń kọ́kọ́ lọ sí àwọn àká.

roster.warriors.grapple_raider.ability.t.en: Swings over walls straight to the nearest defense.
roster.warriors.grapple_raider.ability.t.text: Ó ń fì kọjá lórí ògiri tààrà sí ilé ààbò tí ó sún mọ́ ọn jùlọ.

roster.warriors.mole_king.ability.text.en: Bursts out of the ground beside a defense, stunning it for 2 seconds.
roster.warriors.mole_king.ability.text.text: Ó ń bẹ́ jáde láti inú ilẹ̀ lẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ ilé ààbò kan, ó sì ń mú un dákú fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 2.

roster.warriors.phantom_gate.ability.tex.en: Walls near it crumble, opening a path for everyone.
roster.warriors.phantom_gate.ability.tex.text: Àwọn ògiri tí ó wà nítòsí rẹ̀ ń wó, wọ́n sì ń ṣí ọ̀nà fún gbogbo ènìyàn.

roster.warriors.kite_raider.ability.text.en: Glides over walls on a war kite and bombs defenses.
roster.warriors.kite_raider.ability.text.text: Ó ń fò kọjá ògiri lórí kítì ogun, ó sì ń ju bọ́ǹbù sí àwọn ilé ààbò.

roster.warriors.crane_glider.ability.tex.en: Very fast flyer that raids storehouses.
roster.warriors.crane_glider.ability.tex.text: Ẹni tí ń fò yíyára gan-an tí ń gbógun ti àwọn àká.

roster.warriors.lantern_balloon.ability..en: Slow balloon that drops burning embers in a wide area.
roster.warriors.lantern_balloon.ability..text: Bálúù tí ó lọ́ra tí ń da ẹyín-iná tí ń jó sílẹ̀ ní agbègbè fífẹ̀.

roster.warriors.thunder_kite.ability.tex.en: Lightning hits a defense and up to three nearby defenses for 35% damage each.
roster.warriors.thunder_kite.ability.tex.text: Mànàmáná ń ba ilé ààbò kan àti ilé ààbò tó mẹ́ta nítòsí fún ìpalára 35% ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan.

roster.warriors.dragon_kite_armada.abili.en: A heavy dragon kite carrying a crew of bombers.
roster.warriors.dragon_kite_armada.abili.text: Kítì dírágónì wúwo tí ń gbé ẹgbẹ́ aju-bọ́ǹbù.

roster.warriors.herbalist.ability.text.text: Ó ń wo àwọn jagunjagun tí ó wà nítòsí sàn díẹ̀díẹ̀.

roster.warriors.drum_monk.ability.text.en: Nearby warriors move and attack 25% faster within 3 tiles. Multiple drums do not stack.
roster.warriors.drum_monk.ability.text.text: Àwọn jagunjagun nítòsí ń rìn, wọ́n sì ń kọlù ní 25% yíyára sí i láàrin ààyè 3. Ìlù púpọ̀ kò ní àfikún.

roster.warriors.mist_weaver.ability.text.en: Wraps nearby warriors in thin mist (a small moving smoke cloud).
roster.warriors.mist_weaver.ability.text.text: Ó ń fi ìkùukùu tínrín bo àwọn jagunjagun nítòsí (ìkùukùu èéfín kékeré tí ń rìn).

roster.warriors.spirit_caller.ability.te.en: Brings one fallen warrior back to its feet.
roster.warriors.spirit_caller.ability.te.text: Ó ń gbé jagunjagun kan tí ó ṣubú dìde padà.

roster.warriors.sage_of_clouds.ability.t.en: Once per battle, heals nearby warriors for 25% and grants a 4-second, one-hit shield (blocks up to half their maximum health). Shields cannot be refreshed for 10 seconds.
roster.warriors.sage_of_clouds.ability.t.text: Ẹ̀ẹ̀kan nínú ogun, ó ń wo àwọn jagunjagun nítòsí sàn ní 25%, ó sì ń fún wọn ní apata ìkọlù-kan fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 4 (ó ń dí tó ìdajì ìlera wọn tí ó ga jùlọ). A kò lè sọ apata dọ̀tun fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 10.

roster.warriors.ram_crew.ability.text.en: Four times damage against walls and gates.
roster.warriors.ram_crew.ability.text.text: Ìpalára ìlọ́po mẹ́rin sí ògiri àti ẹnubodè.

roster.warriors.fire_monk.ability.text.en: Short-range fire that burns a small area of buildings.
roster.warriors.fire_monk.ability.text.text: Iná tí kò jìnnà tí ń jó agbègbè kékeré ilé.

roster.warriors.bomb_carrier.ability.tex.en: Runs to the nearest wall or defense and explodes.
roster.warriors.bomb_carrier.ability.tex.text: Ó ń sáré lọ sí ògiri tàbí ilé ààbò tí ó sún mọ́ ọn jùlọ, ó sì ń bú gbàù.

roster.warriors.siege_bombardier.ability.en: Artillery with 5-tile range that fires on defenses. Stops to fire every 2.5 seconds; vulnerable while approaching and cannot move while firing.
roster.warriors.siege_bombardier.ability.text: Àgbá ogun pẹ̀lú àrọ́wọ́tó ààyè 5 tí ń yìnbọn sí àwọn ilé ààbò. Ó ń dúró láti yìnbọn ní gbogbo ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 2.5; ó rọrùn láti pa nígbà tí ó ń sún mọ́, kò sì lè rìn nígbà tí ó ń yìnbọn.

roster.warriors.volcano_cannoneer.abilit.en: Huge splash that leaves burning ground.
roster.warriors.volcano_cannoneer.abilit.text: Ìfọ́nká ńlá tí ń fi ilẹ̀ tí ń jó sílẹ̀.

roster.warriors.hound_handler.ability.te.en: Fights alongside two hunting dogs. The handler and dogs share one health and damage budget.
roster.warriors.hound_handler.ability.te.text: Ó ń jà pẹ̀lú ajá ọdẹ méjì. Olùtọ́jú àti àwọn ajá ń pín ìlera àti ìpalára kan náà.

roster.warriors.hawk_tamer.ability.text.en: Her hawk harries a defense from range, slowing its fire.
roster.warriors.hawk_tamer.ability.text.text: Àṣá rẹ̀ ń yọ ilé ààbò kan lẹ́nu láti ọ̀nà jíjìn, ó sì ń dín ìyára ìtafà rẹ̀ kù.

roster.warriors.boar_rider.ability.text.en: Charges through the first wall in its way.
roster.warriors.boar_rider.ability.text.text: Ó ń rọ́ kọjá ògiri àkọ́kọ́ tí ó wà lójú ọ̀nà rẹ̀.

roster.warriors.bear_warrior.ability.tex.en: Hits much harder below half health.
roster.warriors.bear_warrior.ability.tex.text: Ó ń kọlù gidigidi sí i nígbà tí ìlera rẹ̀ bá wà ní ìsàlẹ̀ ìdajì.

roster.warriors.tiger_lord.ability.text.en: Arrives with two war tigers. Rider and tigers share one health and damage budget.
roster.warriors.tiger_lord.ability.text.text: Ó ń dé pẹ̀lú ẹkùn ogun méjì. Agùnṣin àti àwọn ẹkùn ń pín ìlera àti ìpalára kan náà.

roster.warriors.shadow_stalker.ability.t.en: Cannot be targeted until it attacks for the first time.
roster.warriors.shadow_stalker.ability.t.text: A kò lè dojú kọ ọ́ títí yóò fi kọlù fún ìgbà àkọ́kọ́.

roster.warriors.mirage_twin.ability.text.en: Leaves a decoy that draws fire for 4 seconds.
roster.warriors.mirage_twin.ability.text.text: Ó ń fi ìdẹ kan sílẹ̀ tí ń fa iná mọ́ra fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 4.

roster.warriors.night_blade.ability.text.en: Deals double damage to buildings inside smoke.
roster.warriors.night_blade.ability.text.text: Ó ń ṣe ìpalára ìlọ́po méjì sí àwọn ilé inú èéfín.

roster.warriors.void_walker.ability.text.en: Steps through shadows straight onto its target.
roster.warriors.void_walker.ability.text.text: Ó ń gba inú òjìji kọjá tààrà sórí àfojúsùn rẹ̀.

roster.warriors.eclipse_ninja.ability.te.en: Unseen until its first attack, immune to traps, and has a 25% chance of double damage on each hit.
roster.warriors.eclipse_ninja.ability.te.text: Àìrí títí di ìkọlù rẹ̀ àkọ́kọ́, ìdẹkùn kò lè mú un, ó sì ní àǹfààní 25% láti ṣe ìpalára ìlọ́po méjì ní ìkọlù kọ̀ọ̀kan.

roster.heroes.shadow_captain.ability.tex.en: Nearby warriors fight 30% harder for 8 seconds. Recharges each battle.
roster.heroes.shadow_captain.ability.tex.text: Àwọn jagunjagun nítòsí ń jà ní 30% lágbára sí i fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 8. Ó ń kún padà ní ogun kọ̀ọ̀kan.

roster.heroes.iron_matriarch.ability.tex.en: Raises a wall of shields that blocks defense fire in a cone for 6 seconds.
roster.heroes.iron_matriarch.ability.tex.text: Ó ń gbé ògiri apata sókè tí ń dí iná ilé ààbò ní ìrísí kọ́ọ̀nù fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 6.

roster.heroes.sky_admiral.ability.text.en: Pushes all flyers forward and shields them from anti-air for 5 seconds.
roster.heroes.sky_admiral.ability.text.text: Ó ń ti gbogbo àwọn tí ń fò síwájú, ó sì ń dáàbò bò wọ́n lọ́wọ́ ìdojúkọ ojú ọ̀run fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 5.

roster.heroes.grand_sensei.ability.text.en: Every warrior on the field heals 40% and ignores the next jam, trap or splash.
roster.heroes.grand_sensei.ability.text.text: Gbogbo jagunjagun lójú ogun ń rí ìwòsàn 40%, wọn kò sì ní bìkítà fún ìdílọ́wọ́, ìdẹkùn tàbí ìfọ́nká tó kàn.

social.chatLines.random.1.en: The terraced farms look great after the rain.
social.chatLines.random.1.text: Àwọn oko àtẹ̀gùn rẹwà gan-an lẹ́yìn òjò.

social.chatLines.random.2.text: Mo ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ parí àgbéga Ilé Ìṣúra mi!

social.chatLines.random.3.en: Who wants to raid together later?
social.chatLines.random.3.text: Ta ló fẹ́ ká jọ gbógun ti lẹ́yìn náà?

social.chatLines.random.4.en: My artisans never sleep, I swear.
social.chatLines.random.4.text: Àwọn oníṣẹ́-ọnà mi kì í sùn rárá, mo búra.

social.chatLines.random.5.en: Good luck on your upgrades today!
social.chatLines.random.5.text: Orí ire lórí àwọn àgbéga yín lónìí!

social.chatLines.random.6.en: The Stone Lanterns look so calm at night.
social.chatLines.random.6.text: Àwọn Àtùpà Òkúta dákẹ́ jẹ́ẹ́ gan-an lóru.

social.chatLines.random.7.text: Ẹ rántí láti kó Owó-ẹyọ yín jọ!

social.chatLines.random.8.en: Almost three-starred a fortress just now!
social.chatLines.random.8.text: Mo fẹ́rẹ̀ gba ìràwọ̀ mẹ́ta lórí ibi olódi kan báyìí!

social.chatLines.random.9.en: Shinobi rush is underrated. Fight me.
social.chatLines.random.9.text: A kò mọyì ìrọ́lù Shinobi tó. Ẹ wá bá mi jiyàn.

social.chatLines.random.10.en: Smoke first, then send everything. Works every time.
social.chatLines.random.10.text: Èéfín kọ́kọ́, lẹ́yìn náà rán gbogbo wọn. Ó ń ṣiṣẹ́ nígbà gbogbo.

social.chatLines.random.11.en: Upgrading my Clan Keep, see you in a day!
social.chatLines.random.11.text: Mo ń ṣe àgbéga Ilé Olódi Ìdílé mi, ẹ máa rí mi lẹ́yìn ọjọ́ kan!

social.chatLines.random.12.en: Back from a raid with full storehouses!
social.chatLines.random.12.text: Mo ti dé láti ìgbógunti pẹ̀lú àká tí ó kún!

social.chatLines.random.13.en: Saboteurs on the mortar, then guardians in. Clean.
social.chatLines.random.13.text: Abàjẹ́ sórí àgbá iná, lẹ́yìn náà olùṣọ́ wọlé. Mọ́ tónítóní.

social.chatLines.random.14.en: Who has the tidiest village here?
social.chatLines.random.14.text: Ta ló ní abúlé tí ó mọ́ jùlọ níbí?

social.chatLines.random.15.en: Meditating for a bit, guard my village!
social.chatLines.random.15.text: Mo ń ṣàṣàrò díẹ̀, ẹ bá mi ṣọ́ abúlé mi!

social.chatLines.greet.1.en: Welcome, new ally! Glad to have you.
social.chatLines.greet.1.text: Káàbọ̀, alájọṣe tuntun! Inú wa dùn láti ní ọ.

social.chatLines.greet.2.en: Welcome! Ask if you need warriors.
social.chatLines.greet.2.text: Káàbọ̀! Béèrè tí o bá nílò jagunjagun.

social.chatLines.greet.3.en: A new blade joins us. Welcome!
social.chatLines.greet.3.text: Idà tuntun darapọ̀ mọ́ wa. Káàbọ̀!

social.chatLines.thanks.1.text: Ìwọ ni ẹni tó dára jùlọ, o ṣé!

social.chatLines.thanks.2.text: O ṣé fún àwọn jagunjagun náà!

social.chatLines.raidStart.0.en: Alliance War has started! Use both your attacks!
social.chatLines.raidStart.0.text: Ogun Àjọṣepọ̀ ti bẹ̀rẹ̀! Lo àwọn ìkọlù rẹ méjèèjì!

social.chatLines.raidStart.1.en: Time to raid! Go for the stars!
social.chatLines.raidStart.1.text: Àkókò ìgbógunti ti tó! Ẹ lọ gba ìràwọ̀!

social.chatLines.raidStart.2.en: Alliance War is on, good luck everyone!
social.chatLines.raidStart.2.text: Ogun Àjọṣepọ̀ ti bẹ̀rẹ̀, orí ire fún gbogbo yín!

social.chatLines.raidEnd.0.text: Ogun Àjọṣepọ̀ tó dára, gbogbo yín!

social.chatLines.raidEnd.1.en: That was fun! Same time next week?
social.chatLines.raidEnd.1.text: Ìyẹn dùn mọ́ni! Àkókò kan náà lọ́sẹ̀ tó ń bọ̀?

social.chatLines.donated.0.text: Mo ti fi jagunjagun díẹ̀ ránṣẹ́ sí ọ!

trials.modifiers.elite.description.en: Defenses are 20% tougher and hit 20% harder.
trials.modifiers.elite.description.text: Àwọn ilé ààbò le sí i ní 20%, wọ́n sì ń kọlù gidigidi sí i ní 20%.

troops.hedgehog_roller.description.en: Fast, cheap melee fighter. Dashes to the nearest building.
troops.hedgehog_roller.description.text: Ajàtòsí yíyára, olówó-pọ́ọ́kú. Ó ń sáré lọ sí ilé tí ó sún mọ́ ọn jùlọ.

troops.frog_lobber.description.en: Throws kunai from a distance. Fragile, so keep it behind sturdier warriors.
troops.frog_lobber.description.text: Ó ń ju kunai láti ọ̀nà jíjìn. Ẹlẹgẹ́ ni, nítorí náà fi í sí ẹ̀yìn àwọn jagunjagun tí ó lágbára jù.

troops.beetle_brute.description.en: A heavily armored frontliner who marches straight for defenses and soaks up their fire.
troops.beetle_brute.description.text: Jagunjagun iwájú onihamọ́ra wúwo tí ń rìn tààrà lọ sí àwọn ilé ààbò, tí ó sì ń fara da iná wọn.

troops.owl_bomber.description.en: Glides over walls on a war kite and drops firebombs on defenses. Sky Bow Towers, Shuriken Towers and the Kite-Cutter Ballista can hit it.
troops.owl_bomber.description.text: Ó ń fò kọjá ògiri lórí kítì ogun, ó sì ń ju bọ́ǹbù iná sí àwọn ilé ààbò. Ilé-ìṣọ́ Ọfà Ojú Ọ̀run, Ilé-ìṣọ́ Shuriken àti Ẹ̀rọ-ọfà Agé-Kítì lè ta á.

troops.mole_digger.description.en: Digs under walls to reach any building.
troops.mole_digger.description.text: Ó ń wa ilẹ̀ lábẹ́ ògiri láti dé ilé èyíkéyìí.

troops.saboteur.description.en: Grapples over walls to the nearest working defense and jams it for 6 seconds. One jam per Saboteur; afterwards it fights weakly. A jammed defense can't be jammed again until 10 seconds after it recovers.
troops.saboteur.description.text: Ó ń fi okùn ìkọ́ kọjá ògiri sí ilé ààbò tí ń ṣiṣẹ́ tí ó sún mọ́ ọn jùlọ, ó sì ń dí i lọ́wọ́ fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 6. Ìdílọ́wọ́ kan fún Abàjẹ́ kọ̀ọ̀kan; lẹ́yìn náà ó ń jà láìlágbára. A kò lè dí ilé ààbò tí a ti dí lọ́wọ́ mọ́ títí di ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 10 lẹ́yìn tí ó bá padà bọ̀ sípò.

troops.twin_fang_dancer.description.en: Every hit lands twice, on its target and the next building beside it.
troops.twin_fang_dancer.description.text: Ìkọlù kọ̀ọ̀kan ń ba ibi méjì: àfojúsùn rẹ̀ àti ilé tó kàn lẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ rẹ̀.

troops.wind_step_assassin.description.en: Dashes to a new target; the first hit after each dash deals double damage.
troops.wind_step_assassin.description.text: Ó ń sáré lọ sí àfojúsùn tuntun; ìkọlù àkọ́kọ́ lẹ́yìn ìsáré kọ̀ọ̀kan ń ṣe ìpalára ìlọ́po méjì.

troops.moonblade_master.description.en: Every fourth strike is a crescent slash for 2.5x damage.
troops.moonblade_master.description.text: Ìkọlù kẹrin kọ̀ọ̀kan jẹ́ ìgé bí òṣùpá ẹ̀ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ yọ fún ìpalára 2.5x.

troops.storm_sovereign.description.en: Slashes arc between up to three nearby buildings.
troops.storm_sovereign.description.text: Ìgé rẹ̀ ń fò láàrin ilé mẹ́ta tí ó wà nítòsí.

troops.shuriken_storm.description.en: Throws three shuriken at once; small splash.
troops.shuriken_storm.description.text: Ó ń ju shuriken mẹ́ta lẹ́ẹ̀kan náà; ìfọ́nká kékeré.

troops.blowgun_hunter.description.en: Darts keep damaging a building for 5 seconds.
troops.blowgun_hunter.description.text: Àwọn ọfà ń bá a lọ láti ba ilé jẹ́ fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 5.

troops.chain_sickle_reaper.description.en: Hits make the target take 20% more damage from everyone.
troops.chain_sickle_reaper.description.text: Ìkọlù rẹ̀ ń mú kí àfojúsùn farapa sí i ní 20% láti ọwọ́ gbogbo ènìyàn.

troops.thousand_needle.description.en: Long range (5 tiles) and rapid fire; must stay behind cover.
troops.thousand_needle.description.text: Àrọ́wọ́tó jíjìn (ààyè 5) àti ìtafà kíákíá; ó gbọ́dọ̀ dúró sí ẹ̀yìn ààbò.

troops.iron_monk.description.en: Warriors beside him take 15% less damage.
troops.iron_monk.description.text: Àwọn jagunjagun lẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ rẹ̀ ń farapa díẹ̀ ní 15%.

troops.bell_warden.description.en: Rings a bell that makes defenses in range target him first.
troops.bell_warden.description.text: Ó ń lu agogo tí ń mú kí àwọn ilé ààbò tí ó wà ní àrọ́wọ́tó kọ́kọ́ dojú kọ ọ́.

troops.mountain_shield.description.en: Carries a tower shield that absorbs splash for allies behind him.
troops.mountain_shield.description.text: Ó ń gbé apata gígùn tí ń gba ìfọ́nká fún àwọn alájọṣe tí ó wà lẹ́yìn rẹ̀.

troops.oni_breaker.description.en: Huge health; smashes walls for five times damage.
troops.oni_breaker.description.text: Ìlera ńlá; ó ń fọ́ ògiri pẹ̀lú ìpalára ìlọ́po márùn-ún.

troops.trap_breaker.description.en: Finds and disarms hidden traps along the squad's path.
troops.trap_breaker.description.text: Ó ń rí àwọn ìdẹkùn àṣírí lójú ọ̀nà ẹgbẹ́ náà, ó sì ń tú wọn ká.

troops.gearbreaker.description.en: Two jams per warrior, each lasting 9 seconds.
troops.gearbreaker.description.text: Ìdílọ́wọ́ méjì fún jagunjagun kọ̀ọ̀kan, ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 9.

troops.fuse_master.description.en: Plants a charge on a defense that explodes after 5 seconds.
troops.fuse_master.description.text: Ó ń gbin bọ́ǹbù sórí ilé ààbò kan tí yóò bú gbàù lẹ́yìn ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 5.

troops.ghost_engineer.description.en: Once per battle, jams up to three defenses within 3 tiles for 4 seconds. Shares jam immunity with other specialists.
troops.ghost_engineer.description.text: Ẹ̀ẹ̀kan nínú ogun, ó ń dí ilé ààbò tó mẹ́ta láàrin ààyè 3 lọ́wọ́ fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 4. Ó ń pín àìlèdílọ́wọ́ pẹ̀lú àwọn akọ̀ṣẹ́mọṣẹ́ mìíràn.

troops.wall_climber.description.en: Climbs over walls and goes for storehouses first.
troops.wall_climber.description.text: Ó ń gun orí ògiri kọjá, ó sì ń kọ́kọ́ lọ sí àwọn àká.

troops.grapple_raider.description.en: Swings over walls straight to the nearest defense.
troops.grapple_raider.description.text: Ó ń fì kọjá lórí ògiri tààrà sí ilé ààbò tí ó sún mọ́ ọn jùlọ.

troops.mole_king.description.en: Bursts out of the ground beside a defense, stunning it for 2 seconds.
troops.mole_king.description.text: Ó ń bẹ́ jáde láti inú ilẹ̀ lẹ́gbẹ̀ẹ́ ilé ààbò kan, ó sì ń mú un dákú fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 2.

troops.phantom_gate.description.en: Walls near it crumble, opening a path for everyone.
troops.phantom_gate.description.text: Àwọn ògiri tí ó wà nítòsí rẹ̀ ń wó, wọ́n sì ń ṣí ọ̀nà fún gbogbo ènìyàn.

troops.crane_glider.description.en: Very fast flyer that raids storehouses.
troops.crane_glider.description.text: Ẹni tí ń fò yíyára gan-an tí ń gbógun ti àwọn àká.

troops.lantern_balloon.description.en: Slow balloon that drops burning embers in a wide area.
troops.lantern_balloon.description.text: Bálúù tí ó lọ́ra tí ń da ẹyín-iná tí ń jó sílẹ̀ ní agbègbè fífẹ̀.

troops.thunder_kite.description.en: Lightning hits a defense and up to three nearby defenses for 35% damage each.
troops.thunder_kite.description.text: Mànàmáná ń ba ilé ààbò kan àti ilé ààbò tó mẹ́ta nítòsí fún ìpalára 35% ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan.

troops.dragon_kite_armada.description.en: A heavy dragon kite carrying a crew of bombers.
troops.dragon_kite_armada.description.text: Kítì dírágónì wúwo tí ń gbé ẹgbẹ́ aju-bọ́ǹbù.

troops.herbalist.description.text: Ó ń wo àwọn jagunjagun tí ó wà nítòsí sàn díẹ̀díẹ̀.

troops.drum_monk.description.en: Nearby warriors move and attack 25% faster within 3 tiles. Multiple drums do not stack.
troops.drum_monk.description.text: Àwọn jagunjagun nítòsí ń rìn, wọ́n sì ń kọlù ní 25% yíyára sí i láàrin ààyè 3. Ìlù púpọ̀ kò ní àfikún.

troops.mist_weaver.description.en: Wraps nearby warriors in thin mist (a small moving smoke cloud).
troops.mist_weaver.description.text: Ó ń fi ìkùukùu tínrín bo àwọn jagunjagun nítòsí (ìkùukùu èéfín kékeré tí ń rìn).

troops.spirit_caller.description.en: Brings one fallen warrior back to its feet.
troops.spirit_caller.description.text: Ó ń gbé jagunjagun kan tí ó ṣubú dìde padà.

troops.sage_of_clouds.description.en: Once per battle, heals nearby warriors for 25% and grants a 4-second, one-hit shield (blocks up to half their maximum health). Shields cannot be refreshed for 10 seconds.
troops.sage_of_clouds.description.text: Ẹ̀ẹ̀kan nínú ogun, ó ń wo àwọn jagunjagun nítòsí sàn ní 25%, ó sì ń fún wọn ní apata ìkọlù-kan fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 4 (ó ń dí tó ìdajì ìlera wọn tí ó ga jùlọ). A kò lè sọ apata dọ̀tun fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 10.

troops.ram_crew.description.en: Four times damage against walls and gates.
troops.ram_crew.description.text: Ìpalára ìlọ́po mẹ́rin sí ògiri àti ẹnubodè.

troops.fire_monk.description.en: Short-range fire that burns a small area of buildings.
troops.fire_monk.description.text: Iná tí kò jìnnà tí ń jó agbègbè kékeré ilé.

troops.bomb_carrier.description.en: Runs to the nearest wall or defense and explodes.
troops.bomb_carrier.description.text: Ó ń sáré lọ sí ògiri tàbí ilé ààbò tí ó sún mọ́ ọn jùlọ, ó sì ń bú gbàù.

troops.siege_bombardier.description.en: Artillery with 5-tile range that fires on defenses. Stops to fire every 2.5 seconds; still inside a Kunai Tower's reach, and a Longbow Yagura hunts it.
troops.siege_bombardier.description.text: Àgbá ogun pẹ̀lú àrọ́wọ́tó ààyè 5 tí ń yìnbọn sí àwọn ilé ààbò. Ó ń dúró láti yìnbọn ní gbogbo ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 2.5; ó ṣì wà ní àrọ́wọ́tó Ilé-ìṣọ́ Kunai, Yagura Ọrun Gígùn sì ń dọdẹ rẹ̀.

troops.volcano_cannoneer.description.en: Huge splash that leaves burning ground.
troops.volcano_cannoneer.description.text: Ìfọ́nká ńlá tí ń fi ilẹ̀ tí ń jó sílẹ̀.

troops.hound_handler.description.en: Fights alongside two hunting dogs. The handler and dogs share one health and damage budget.
troops.hound_handler.description.text: Ó ń jà pẹ̀lú ajá ọdẹ méjì. Olùtọ́jú àti àwọn ajá ń pín ìlera àti ìpalára kan náà.

troops.hawk_tamer.description.en: Her hawk harries a defense from range, slowing its fire.
troops.hawk_tamer.description.text: Àṣá rẹ̀ ń yọ ilé ààbò kan lẹ́nu láti ọ̀nà jíjìn, ó sì ń dín ìyára ìtafà rẹ̀ kù.

troops.boar_rider.description.en: Charges through the first wall in its way.
troops.boar_rider.description.text: Ó ń rọ́ kọjá ògiri àkọ́kọ́ tí ó wà lójú ọ̀nà rẹ̀.

troops.bear_warrior.description.en: Hits much harder below half health.
troops.bear_warrior.description.text: Ó ń kọlù gidigidi sí i nígbà tí ìlera rẹ̀ bá wà ní ìsàlẹ̀ ìdajì.

troops.tiger_lord.description.en: Arrives with two war tigers. Rider and tigers share one health and damage budget.
troops.tiger_lord.description.text: Ó ń dé pẹ̀lú ẹkùn ogun méjì. Agùnṣin àti àwọn ẹkùn ń pín ìlera àti ìpalára kan náà.

troops.shadow_stalker.description.en: Cannot be targeted until it attacks for the first time.
troops.shadow_stalker.description.text: A kò lè dojú kọ ọ́ títí yóò fi kọlù fún ìgbà àkọ́kọ́.

troops.mirage_twin.description.en: Leaves a decoy that draws fire for 4 seconds.
troops.mirage_twin.description.text: Ó ń fi ìdẹ kan sílẹ̀ tí ń fa iná mọ́ra fún ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 4.

troops.night_blade.description.en: Deals double damage to buildings inside smoke.
troops.night_blade.description.text: Ó ń ṣe ìpalára ìlọ́po méjì sí àwọn ilé inú èéfín.

troops.void_walker.description.en: Steps through shadows straight onto its target.
troops.void_walker.description.text: Ó ń gba inú òjìji kọjá tààrà sórí àfojúsùn rẹ̀.

troops.eclipse_ninja.description.en: Unseen until its first attack, immune to traps, and has a 25% chance of double damage on each hit.
troops.eclipse_ninja.description.text: Àìrí títí di ìkọlù rẹ̀ àkọ́kọ́, ìdẹkùn kò lè mú un, ó sì ní àǹfààní 25% láti ṣe ìpalára ìlọ́po méjì ní ìkọlù kọ̀ọ̀kan.
